_comment: A card that exists only for the return-to-origin test (tests/unit/test_return_to_origin.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_cloak` is Cloak and Dagger, Entwined: one exile that can take a card out of a hand or a permanent off the battlefield, and one return that has to undo whichever happened.

cards.name: Test Cloak
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, choose target opponent and up to one target creature they control. You may exile a nonland card from their hand or the chosen creature until this creature leaves the battlefield.

abilities.text: When this creature enters, choose target opponent and up to one target creature they control. You may exile a nonland card from their hand or the chosen creature until this creature leaves the battlefield.
When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to the zone it came from.
